title: Experiment Context Resolution
description: POST /api/v1/experiment-context/resolve, body {experiment_ref} (moved from GET /api/v1beta/experiments/{experiment_id}/context in API revision Phase 3 slice 3.3 window 1b; operationId experiment_context.get_experiment_context, replay class read: no reservation, fingerprint or replay row; the request body is closed and the reference is never echoed in any error). Original design: (SPEC: ~/.claude/plans/deeplink-context/SPEC.md, astra APPROVE WITH CHANGES 2026-09-28). Deep-link recovery for SDK/Claude Code links of the form .../experiments/view/{id}: when a link opens under the wrong tenant, the frontend calls this route once to learn which tenant/project the experiment actually lives in, then atomically switches and retries. The route is authenticated but CONTEXT-INDEPENDENT -- it does not require or consume X-Tenant-Id/X-Project-Id and is exempt from stale tenant/project context middleware rejection; only authentication is retained. Human sessions (JWT/cookie) only: an API-key principal is rejected uniformly before any lookup (403, error_code CONTEXT_RESOLUTION_HUMAN_ONLY), never enumerated against the key owner's memberships. The lookup enumerates only the authenticated human's own ACTIVE tenant memberships (existing self-membership discovery) and, within each tenant, reuses the experiment detail route's real visibility policy (project read role + ownership visibility) rather than re-deriving it -- so an experiment that exists but is not visible to the caller in any of their active tenants is indistinguishable from one that does not exist at all: both return the exact same closed 404 (ExperimentContextNotFoundError). Active tenant membership is required even for platform admins; there is no cross-tenant admin bypass on this route. The membership probe is bounded (a fixed cap on tenants probed and on wall time); exceeding the bound is a 503 (ExperimentContextBudgetExceededError, error_code CONTEXT_RESOLUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) so a caller never receives a false 404 from a silently truncated search. The 200 body is bare (x-wrap-status: bare, not the {success,message,data} envelope) and closed: experiment_id/project_id/tenant_id are always present; tenant_name/project_name are optional display strings for the frontend's "Opened in workspace X / project Y" toast and carry no authorization meaning of their own. Every response (success or error) is sent with Cache-Control: private, no-store.

ExperimentContextResponse.description: 200 body, bare (no success/message/data envelope). experiment_ref is the requested body member, echoed back only after the lookup has authorized it; project_id/tenant_id are the resolved owning scope the frontend must pin before retrying the experiment fetch. tenant_name/project_name are optional convenience labels for the toast only.

experiment_ref.description: The requested experiment reference, echoed back. Present only once the lookup has confirmed the caller may read this experiment in tenant_id/project_id.

project_id.description: The project the experiment belongs to, within tenant_id, restricted to a project the caller can read.

tenant_id.description: The tenant the experiment belongs to, drawn only from the caller's own ACTIVE memberships -- never a tenant the caller does not actively belong to.

tenant_name.description: Optional display name of tenant_id, for the "Opened in workspace X / project Y" toast. Absent does not imply the tenant lacks a name; the client falls back to tenant_id.

project_name.description: Optional display name of project_id, for the same toast. Absent does not imply the project lacks a name; the client falls back to project_id.

ExperimentContextResolveRequest.description: POST body of experiment_context.get_experiment_context. Closed: experiment_ref is the only member and is required; any other key, a missing or non-string reference, or a value that is not experiment_ plus 32 lowercase hex is a 400 ExperimentContextBadRequestError, validated before any membership lookup. A legacy experiment id is not a reference and is rejected the same way; nothing casts between the two.

ExperimentContextBadRequestError.description: 400, closed. One fixed body for every malformed request (unknown key, missing member, wrong type, malformed reference). It never echoes the submitted key, value or reference and carries no details member.

ExperimentContextNotFoundError.description: The single closed 404 shape, returned identically whether experiment_ref names no experiment anywhere, or names one the caller cannot read in any of their active tenants. Deliberately indistinguishable: no field here can reveal existence.

ExperimentContextAuthenticationRequiredE.description: 401: no authenticated session (human or API key) on the request. Distinct from the 403 API-key rejection below, which requires a recognized API-key principal.

ExperimentContextApiKeyRejectedError.description: 403: the caller authenticated with an API key rather than a human (JWT/cookie) session. Rejected uniformly before any membership lookup -- the response never varies with the key or its owner's memberships, so it cannot be used to enumerate them.

message.const: This endpoint requires a human session.

ExperimentContextBudgetExceededError.description: 503: the bounded membership probe (tenant count and/or wall-time cap) was exhausted before the lookup could complete. Retryable -- the caller has not been told the experiment is absent, only that the search did not finish in budget; a client SHOULD retry rather than treat this as a 404.

message.const: Context resolution is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
